About Treasures Of Osiris

REEVO has gone live with Thunder Walker, a Greek mythology slot centered on Zeus. It adds another entry to the studio’s growing catalog of legend-inspired reels. The launch expands REEVO’s portfolio of gaming content and puts another mythology-inspired title into its offering.

The news value here is less about the individual game than about what it signals. REEVO is continuing to lean on one of the most heavily worked themes in online slots. The studio is packaging a familiar setting alongside a mix of mechanics rather than a single standout engine.

Thunder Walker has a 5×5 reel layout with 50 paylines and a range of themed features. With a medium volatility profile, a reported RTP of 95.72% and a maximum win of 2,358x the bet, the game sits toward the more measured end of the market. This is not one of the high-ceiling, high-variance releases that dominate headlines.
